span.p:
Covered channel + required strand kinds → Ok
Missing required kind → Frayed result (no state change)
Uncovered channel → NotCovered → Reject
Permit also requires writer binding and weave coherence

span.p:
Covered channel → Frayed result
Uncovered channel → NotCovered → Reject
DegradeToProposal grants no write authority
Staging requires proposal eligibility; protected targets reject
Repeated fray calls do not automatically snap

span.p:
Every channel → Snapped → Reject
A new authority ceremony is required
